title: Resolution urging governor to sign veterans job listing bill
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Governor to sign S.2071-A/A.6084-A, which would require the State Department of Labor to create and maintain a list of available careers and job openings for veterans. The list would be shared with the Department of Veterans' Services, regularly updated, and posted on that agency's website. The bill passed the State Senate on April 13, 2026 and the Assembly on June 3, 2026 but had not yet been delivered to or signed by the Governor.
